scope: Readiness of every HortiMulti dataset-mode-algorithm with planned runs after commit e880c2c: one check per combination on the whole strawberry03 (242 s) through main's pipeline; applies to both sequences (the configurations are per dataset, OKVIS per sequence differing only in g0).
review_basis: Declared claim items are settled by recorded user decisions (2026-10-05, docs/hortimulti-decisions-20261005.md): one IMU noise profile for every HortiMulti estimator (recording-derived densities, published random walks); one camera-clock IMU input (published Kalibr shift subtracted in the dataset files, manifest.json) with every native offset zero; OpenVINS track_frequency above every camera interval; OV2SLAM accurate-profile values; repaired Voxel-SVIO and OpenVINS builds; ORB-SLAM3 ThDepth 40 and AirSLAM depth_upper_thr 15 m reviewed and kept. The reference origin and clock are handled in evaluation (Ouster os_sensor working convention, strawberry03 strongly supported, strawberry02 unresolved; SE(3) and Sim(3) reported, reference not rescaled) and stay claim limits, not execution blockers. Failures under a correct setup stay as measured results; AirSLAM keeps its sparse keyframe claim; OKVIS2-X LC final-BA extrinsic optimisation is disclosed; VIO and VIO-LC stay separate executions; ORB-SLAM3 attempts outside ZED are replaced in one new group (user-rerun-decisions-20261003.json).
